promptNotes.text:
## Toolchain

This machine has no system C/C++ compiler, no .NET SDK, and no system `pip`; host `sudo` requires a password, so it cannot be used by an unattended session. Use a rootless **toolbox** container named `instant-meshes-build` instead: `toolbox list -c instant-meshes-build` checks whether it exists, `toolbox create -y -c instant-meshes-build` creates it if not. Inside that toolbox, `sudo dnf install -y <packages>` works without a password prompt. Run every build/test/run command for this plan via `toolbox run -c instant-meshes-build <command>`; the toolbox mounts your home directory at the same path, so repo-relative paths work unchanged. Never attempt `sudo` on the host directly.
